ns2:course.label: Encounters in Native America
ns2:course.description: An examination of pivotal events in the history of Native peoples in North America. Students will explore the complexity of encounters between American Indians and others through a focus on key moments. These will include religious encounters, military confrontations, and legal struggles as well as social and artistic interactions. Same as AIS 277.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Hist & Phil, and Cultural Studies - US Minority course.
